goals: Show the canonical accepted Stack version and both independent test-slot identities on the dedicated Workbench title screen before a world is entered.
scope: Render only the three manager-owned lines from .mynx-runtime-v2-title.json: Baseline Stack version plus Slot A and Slot B canonical project display names and Canary numbers or Empty.
Fail visibly on a missing or invalid projection and never consult retired V1 marker metadata as title state.

exclusions: No independent accepted-baseline, slot, result, artifact, or project-name database.
No gameplay behavior, world access, automatic Minecraft launch, or runtime-validation inference.
No deployment outside the dedicated Minecraft 26.2 Workbench profile or outside the Test Instance Manager transaction.

dependencies.reason: Canonical owner and atomic publisher of the validated title projection and marker artifact.

state.milestone: The exact current release is ACCEPTED by owner direction following the user's external/gameplay testing. Existing build, deployment, and runtime classifications are preserved; this administrative transition infers no new runtime result.
